definitions.explanation: Having insufficient light; not completely dark but lacking adequate brightness. Often describes twilight or shadowy environments.

examples.japanese: {薄暗|うすぐら}い⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧
⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧になって⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄暗|うすぐら}く⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It became dusky as evening approached.

examples.japanese: {薄暗|うすぐら}い⟦{路地裏|ろじうら}→路地裏：09382_rojiura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧。
examples.english: It's scary to walk alone through dimly lit back alleys.

notes:
FORMATION: Compound of ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ (thin, faint) + ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧ (dark). The く becomes ぐ through rendaku (sequential voicing).

CONJUGATION: Regular i-adjective: {薄暗|うすぐら}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, {薄暗|うすぐら}かった, {薄暗|うすぐら}くて, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄暗|うすぐら}い⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧/⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧/⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧ (dim room/hallway/alley)
- {薄暗|うすぐら}い⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in the dim light)
- ⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄暗|うすぐら}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (the area becomes dim)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧ (dark - stronger darkness)
- {仄暗|ほのぐら}い (faintly dark - literary)
- ほの{暗|ぐら}い (dimly lit - alternative form)

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {薄暗|うすぐら}くなかったら
